not_found: Objective or key result not found.
conflict: This objective or setting changed. Reload before trying again.
read_only: Restore or reopen this objective before editing it.
why: From the 3-year horizon, explain why this objective matters.
outcome: Describe the expected outcome for an annual or quarterly objective.
dates: Choose two ordered dates between 2000 and 2100.
quarter_details: A quarterly objective needs a first action, two dates and at least one key result.
one_month: The quarterly plan must fit within one month: at most the day before the same date next month.
duplicate: Each key result needs a distinct identifier.
parent: Link an objective in the same domain at the immediately longer horizon.
parent_archived: This parent objective is archived. Restore it before selecting it.
children: This objective has linked objectives. Move them before changing its horizon or domain.
limit: The limit of 5,000 objectives has been reached.
unfinished: Reach every key result before completing the objective.
timezone: Choose a valid IANA timezone, such as Europe/Paris.
target: The target must differ from the starting value.
metric_completed_description: Distinct first completions in the period, even after reopening or archiving. Area and horizon at first completion.
metric_key_results_description: First key results reached in the period, without counting corrections twice. Filters frozen at first success.
metric_check_ins_description: Progress check-ins confirmed in the period. Explicit corrections count; edits in the objective form do not.
